notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Temporal Manipulation and Displace.
description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation and Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
